Method of Attack: Ransomware that locks the Qiui Cellmate Bluetooth-controlled chastity device remotely
Communicates with Qiui's API endpoints to enumerate user info, send messages to victim app, and add friends
Exploits vulnerability in Qiui Cellmate device allowing remote locking without authentication using a six-digit friend code
Attack Vector: Remote API requests without authentication exploiting vulnerability in Qiui Cellmate device
Indicators of Compromise: Exfiltration of user data including location, phone number, plaintext password
